identity.label: Grouped adaptive loss weighting lowers final-network fitted-interval retention error

claims.statement: Grouped adaptive loss weighting reduced final-network relative L2 retention error over the fitted interval compared with fixed coefficients in all ten paired Allen--Cahn seeds; both arms retained the same positive rate-normalised RK4 term.
claims.direction: grouped_rate1 minus fixed_rate1 is negative for final-network fitted-interval retention error; both arms use positive rate-normalised RK4
claims.qualification: This is a frozen secondary grouped-versus-fixed contrast. Held-out direct, continuation and terminal evidence limits generalisation of the training result.

identity.label: No observed held-out reduction

claims.statement: The confirmatory data did not demonstrate a grouped-over-fixed error reduction on direct validation, direct test, numerical-continuation test or terminal-state evaluation.
claims.direction: two-sided 95 percent paired t intervals include zero on all four held-out or terminal criteria
claims.intended_use: Formal scope boundary for the adaptive-controller result.
claims.qualification: Failure to observe a reduction is not evidence of equivalence or absence of an effect.

identity.label: No growing long-sequence advantage

claims.statement: The three-seed development study did not show growing support for a grouped-over-fixed final-network fitted-interval retention advantage as the number of temporal blocks increased.
claims.direction: fitted-interval retention-error difference slope is non-negative across 4, 8 and 12 blocks
claims.intended_use: Development-only boundary on the proposed long-sequence mechanism.
claims.qualification: The linked locked protocol records only three paired seeds per block count; this is development evidence rather than confirmatory inference.

identity.label: Controller budget diagnostics

claims.statement: The grouped controller maintained its configured within-group coefficient budgets while allocating a majority of the active later-block constraint budget to replay, with no recorded guard triggers.
claims.direction: budget discrepancies are at floating-point scale, guard count is zero, and median later-block replay share exceeds one half
claims.qualification: Updates within each trace are serially dependent and no mediator was randomized. These diagnostics establish controller behaviour and budget invariants, not improved held-out prediction or a causal mediator effect.
